source: Journey OS Production Bible §08 — MisconceptionCategory (G01). 15 clinically-specific misconceptions for distractor generation.

categories.name: Cardiac biomarker timing confusion
categories.description: Confuses CK-MB with high-sensitivity Troponin I as first-line ACS biomarker
categories.example_distractor_pattern: CK-MB instead of hs-TnI for early MI detection

categories.name: ACS type misidentification by ECG pattern
categories.description: Confuses NSTEMI / unstable angina / STEMI classification from ECG and biomarker pattern
categories.example_distractor_pattern: STEMI when only ST depression present

categories.name: Diuretic tubular site confusion
categories.description: Confuses site of action: loop diuretic (LOH) vs. thiazide (DCT) vs. K-sparing (collecting duct)
categories.example_distractor_pattern: HCTZ instead of furosemide for loop diuretic effect

categories.name: Drug mechanism vs. clinical indication conflation
categories.description: Selects a drug based on its clinical indication rather than its mechanism when mechanism is asked
categories.example_distractor_pattern: Drug that treats the condition vs. drug with the asked mechanism

categories.name: Stroke vascular territory misattribution
categories.description: Confuses MCA / ACA / PCA / vertebrobasilar territory deficits from clinical presentation
categories.example_distractor_pattern: ACA territory when contralateral face + arm weakness present

categories.name: UMN vs. LMN sign confusion
categories.description: Confuses upper and lower motor neuron findings: hyper vs. hyporeflexia, spasticity vs. flaccidity
categories.example_distractor_pattern: Hyperreflexia and spasticity for LMN lesion

categories.name: Gram stain and organism property conflation
categories.description: Confuses Gram-positive vs. Gram-negative organisms, their typical presentations, or their antimicrobial coverage

categories.name: Antibiotic mechanism of action error
categories.description: Confuses cell wall synthesis inhibitors / protein synthesis inhibitors / DNA gyrase inhibitors by drug class
categories.example_distractor_pattern: Macrolide as cell wall synthesis inhibitor

categories.name: Endocrine feedback axis direction error
categories.description: Confuses primary vs. secondary vs. tertiary causes: whether hormone levels go up or down and at which gland
categories.example_distractor_pattern: High TSH in hyperthyroidism (primary thyroid disorder)

categories.name: Acute vs. chronic inflammation cell confusion
categories.description: Confuses neutrophil (acute) vs. lymphocyte/macrophage (chronic) vs. eosinophil (parasitic/allergic) predominance
categories.example_distractor_pattern: Neutrophils as predominant cell in granulomatous disease

categories.name: Necrosis type misidentification
categories.description: Confuses coagulative / liquefactive / caseous / fat / fibrinoid necrosis by tissue context

categories.name: Sensitivity vs. specificity and predictive value confusion
categories.description: Confuses sensitivity/specificity with PPV/NPV, or misapplies screening vs. confirmatory test logic
categories.example_distractor_pattern: High sensitivity test to confirm diagnosis in low-prevalence setting

categories.name: Epidemiological study design conflation
categories.description: Confuses case-control / cohort / cross-sectional / RCT designs and their appropriate measures of association
categories.example_distractor_pattern: Odds ratio calculated from a cohort study

categories.name: Outdated clinical guideline application
categories.description: Selects an answer based on an older clinical guideline that has been superseded by current evidence-based practice
categories.example_distractor_pattern: CK-MB as preferred biomarker, bed rest for back pain

categories.name: Premature intervention before stabilization
categories.description: Selects definitive intervention before ensuring airway / breathing / circulation or before ordering the appropriate next diagnostic step
categories.example_distractor_pattern: Surgery before resuscitation in hemorrhagic shock
